notices.text: If the bores are scored, the accepted repair on an M96 is to machine the case and install billet aluminium nickel-silicon-carbide plated cylinders (Nickies) with matched oversize forged pistons. NEVER use a steel sleeve in an M96 — the thermal expansion mismatch against the aluminium case is exactly the wrong answer and the industry consensus is unambiguous about it. Budget roughly USD 5,000-6,000 for case machining plus Nickies plus oversize forged pistons. The case halves must be align-bored/honed as a matched pair if the main bores are out. Decide bore size (96 mm stock, or 102/104 mm big-bore) before machining, because it sets the piston, ring and head gasket choice.
